selection: Choose model/threshold/hybrid solely from group-disjoint training OOF predictions; benchmark and applicability labels are used only after selection is saved. No promotion merely to improve a headline.
benchmark_use: Preserved historical regression benchmark, already observed in prior work; not a new pristine final test. Also report template-disjoint subset.
rule_policy: Only predeclared full-match named-school or single-attribute lookup rules can override the learned class. Enable them only if OOF empirical precision >=0.95 with at least 30 rule firings. No fuzzy lookup or benchmark-derived exceptions.
applicability: Assistant-authored policy-labeled tests; freeze before predictions, report overlaps, not independent users or real traffic.
quality_gate: Engineering completion, benchmark quality, independent validation and live integration are four separate statuses. A successful build never implies production authorization.
training_review: Preserve source CSV. Uniformly adjudicate equivalent query templates under the frozen route meanings; separately attribute changes. Exclude context-dependent reviews.
